title: Governments hide the bodies for Cold War reverse engineering

tellings.quote: One of the governments most interested in hiding things is the one that does the most reverse engineering. And those have been all the things that happened during the Cold War era.

plain: On a show hosted by a podcaster named Jesse Michels, a man named David Ruiz, speaking about strange three-fingered bodies said to come from Peru, says the governments most eager to hide such things are the ones that do the most reverse engineering, meaning taking apart an object to learn how to build it. He ties this to what went on during the Cold War, the long standoff between the US and the Soviet Union, implying the bodies are kept hidden to stay ahead in that race.
